reviews.text: Ultra (UOS) is a gaming platform blockchain. Launched in 2019, it has a Steam-like experience with NFTs. In 2025, it has deals with publishers. PoS network. Gamer-focused.

Ultra (UOS) is a blockchain platform for the gaming industry. It aims to be an all-in-one gaming ecosystem with a game store, tournament platform and social network, everything laying on its own Ethereum-compatible chain. Its 2025 roadmap speaks of Netflix-style game subscriptions and integration with Sony/Thomson, though, at the moment, those are not defined yet on stone.

Ultra is an EVM compatible layer 1 block chain and gaming hub that aims to provide a web3 alternative to centralized personal computer game distribution platforms. Ultra uses a fairer revenue split and ownership model through NFTs. They have a decentralized game store where players purchase games, Uniq Marketplace where players can buy and resell their NFT based games and in game collectibles which enable developers to earn royalties on every secondary sale. Additionally, they have Ultra Arena, an esports tournament platform that hosts competitions for popular games and a non custodial wallet. The protocol securities strategic partnerships with Ubisoft, AMD, Intel Gaming and Thomson Computing.
Ultra was founded by an experienced team funded by NOIA Capital.

Ultra is a gaming focused blockchain that I know is trying to give more revenue share to gamers and developers kind of like a Web3 Steam. I like the vision that players can earn tokens through gameplay and participate in distribution. It’s cool that they built a dedicated fast chain. My caveat is that it’s still pretty small: not many big games have launched on it yet, and success depends on attracting major studios, which hasn’t fully materialized. It’s ambitious, but it’s still waiting to prove itself in the real gaming world.

Ultra (with its native token UOS) is a blockchain-powered gaming ecosystem designed to disrupt traditional gaming distribution and offer a Web3-enabled platform for gamers, developers, and creators. UOS serves as the utility token used for all transactions within the Ultra ecosystem, including game purchases, in game items, NFT marketplace interactions, staking, and rewards.
Ultra aims to combine the convenience and accessibility of traditional gaming platforms with the transparency, user ownership, and incentives enabled by blockchain technology.
